system-characteristics.description: AWS-hosted CUI enclave implementing CMMC Level 2 (NIST SP 800-171 Rev. 2). See oscal/ and terraform/.

information-types.title: Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI)
information-types.description: Federal CUI processed, stored, or transmitted by the system.

authorization-boundary.description: Single AWS account (CUI/workload) plus a separate log-archive account. SCPs enforce the boundary. Out-of-scope assets have no IAM/network path to CUI.

components.title: CMMC L2 CUI Enclave (this system)
components.description: The overall AWS environment defined by this project.

control-implementation.description: Implementation of all 110 CMMC L2 practices. Status, AWS service, and evidence location are carried as props on each implemented-requirement.
